Model API

group ALI_MODEL_API

Function declarations for Ali models.

Functions

mesh_msg_send_cause_t ali_attr_get(mesh_model_info_t *pmodel_info, uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, uint8_t tid, ali_attr_type_t attr_type[], uint8_t type_num)

Ali attribute get.

Parameters:

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to model info.

  • dst -- [in] Destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] AppKey index.

  • tid -- [in] Transaction ID.

  • attr_type -- [in] Attribute type.

  • type_num -- [in] Type number.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- The message send was successful.

  • Others -- The message send failed.

Returns:

Send status.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t ali_attr_conf(mesh_model_info_t *pmodel_info, const mesh_msg_t *pmesh_msg, uint8_t tid)

Ali attribute confirmation.

Parameters:

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to model info.

  • pmesh_msg -- [in] Pointer to mesh message.

  • tid -- [in] Transaction ID.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- The attribute confirmation was sent successfully.

  • Others -- The attribute confirmation failed to send.

Returns:

Send status.

Send raw data message with Ali attribute.

bool ali_model_reg(uint8_t element_index, mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info, bool server)

Register Ali model.

Parameters:

  • element_index -- [in] Element index.

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to model info.

  • server -- [in] True for server model, false for client model.

Return values:

  • true -- Registration successful.

  • false -- Registration failed. Ensure that the model info is correct and try again.

Returns:

Registration status.
